parent_selection_note: Not choosing a training parent or rolling back. 252 stays training_eligible false; 180 stays accepted reference.
canonical_definition: Per mode, per-seed alive frames sorted ascending over 64 seeds; Q1 = mean of first 16, Q4 = mean of last 16, mean = mean of all 64. Not inclusive percentiles.

reused_runner.policy: copy into new prepare dir; do not edit prior dir

cohort.choice: reuse existing 64 development seeds 3489660928..3489660991 (no new seeds)
cohort.why: fastest, matches both dev records and campaign-r1 paired controls, no new seed reservation needed
cohort.dev_use_caveat: these seeds are already used for checkpoint dev observation, so they are diagnostic only; not held-out qualification
cohort.future_training_constraint: any future training-selection or checkpoint decision that reads this diagnostic must exclude these 64 seeds from selection or mark them diagnostic-only; no implicit exclusion added to config here
cohort.fresh_cohort_alternative: not chosen for r1. Would need a declared new seed range and reservation decision; seeds.py reserves test seeds for frozen recipe. Parent decides if needed.

episodes.argmax_control_rule: argmax rows must match saved dev JSONL per-seed fields field-for-field: episode_index, seed, score_raw_fixed, score, alive_frames, gameplay_frames, terminated, truncated, objective_return. Mismatch stops the whole run with no retry.

game.cap_policy: episodes hitting cap are reported as censored; cap count must be 0 for the primary table, else flagged

action_rng.argmax: deterministic; no RNG draws; one run per checkpoint-seed
action_rng.seed_reset: torch.manual_seed and torch.mps.manual_seed once before each checkpoint x replicate evaluation, after checkpoint load
action_rng.draw_order: sorted active episode indices; one batched draw per policy step (same as r3)
action_rng.per_seed_sampled_value: mean of 3 replicate values for that seed

resources.expected_wall_seconds: about 40-90 for 512 episodes, scaled from campaign-r1 (47.7 s for 768 episodes); well inside 600

per_checkpoint_mode.deaths_by_cause: normal_enemy, kamikaze_enemy, kamikaze_explosion, moving_pattern_rect, static_pattern_rect, unknown, unavailable

paired_contrasts.definition: sampled_mean3 - argmax per seed, checkpoint best180
sampled_mean3 - argmax per seed, checkpoint latest252

output_schema.replicate_noise_floor: per seed SD across 3 controller replicates, reported as median and max, per checkpoint

bootstrap.method: percentile; resample seed indices once, reuse across all metrics
bootstrap.conditional_on: fixed checkpoint pair and environment-seed sampling; not training-replicate uncertainty

decision_rules.scope: exploratory diagnostics; not qualification; no training eligibility change
decision_rules.env_seed_difference: C1 CI excludes 0 and |mean| >= 100 frames: argmax checkpoint difference is real on this cohort. CI inside (-100,100): practically similar. Otherwise inconclusive.
decision_rules.action_mode_sensitivity: C2 or C3 CI excludes 0 with |mean| >= 100: sampled vs argmax matters for that checkpoint. CI inside (-100,100): insensitive.
decision_rules.interaction: C4 CI excludes 0 with |mean| >= 100: action-mode sensitivity differs between checkpoints.
decision_rules.report_all: all contrasts reported regardless of outcome; no multiple-comparison claim beyond stated CIs

T1_env_seed_variation.claim: the 180 to 252 argmax gap is finite-seed noise
T1_env_seed_variation.predicts: C1 CI includes 0; replicate noise floor comparable to C1 width
T1_env_seed_variation.weakened_by: C1 CI excludes 0 with |mean| >= 100, or C1 median and mean disagree in sign with narrow CI, or the 252 argmax gap is larger than the sampled replicate noise floor
T1_env_seed_variation.supported_by: C1 CI inside (-100,100) or straddles 0 with width > 100 frames

T2_action_mode_sensitivity.claim: the 180 to 252 gap depends on argmax versus sampled action selection
T2_action_mode_sensitivity.predicts: C4 CI excludes 0, or C5 sign or size changes between argmax and sampled
T2_action_mode_sensitivity.weakened_by: C4 CI includes 0, or C5 has same sign and similar size as C1 in both modes
T2_action_mode_sensitivity.supported_by: C4 CI excludes 0, or C1 CI includes 0 while C5 CI excludes 0

expected_limits: 64 seeds give wide CIs; a null result is likely and is not evidence of equivalence unless CI is inside the practical margin
bootstrap does not cover training-replicate variance; one checkpoint per arm
dev seeds are reused; no held-out claim
sampled values depend on controller seeds and draw order; 3 replicates is a small noise sample
weakening_rules_to_report: If C1 and C4 both have CIs including 0, the data does not separate T1 from T2 on this cohort; report that outcome as inconclusive, not as a win for either theory.
budget_justification: Smallest useful design: two checkpoints, 64 existing seeds, 4 action evaluations per seed-checkpoint (1 argmax + 3 sampled). 512 episodes sit below campaign-r1's measured 768-episode run at 47.7 s, so 600 s cap and 10 s cleanup reserve are generous; RSS and MPS caps stay at 6 GiB each per protocol.
design_choices_for_parent: Reuse 64 dev seeds instead of fresh seeds; parent may override with a declared fresh range plus reservation
Controller seeds 64001-64003 reused from r3 for comparability
Per-episode raw frame cap 18000 kept from r3; censoring reported, not hidden
not_done: no model, checkpoint, optimizer, source, ledger, or lease edits
no Torch load, environment step, gradient, or child work
